title: iReview: AI-to-AI code review with I-Lang v5.0 vector judgment
description: iReview replaces English prose between models with a protocol. The calling agent sends an I-Lang operation chain describing what to review, and the reviewing model returns I-Lang declarations: one record per finding with file, line, severity and confidence. Severity comes from the v5.0 judgment vector rather than keyword matching. It works with any OpenAI-compatible model, supports standard and adversarial modes and multi-model chains, and needs only Git, Bash and Python 3.
